fixture.purpose: Clearly labeled generated evaluation input; references are never supplied to inference
fixture.license: CC0-1.0 for this original procedural audio
fixture.vocals: Synthetic vowel-like excitation with ±0.6-semitone 5.4Hz vibrato; not human singing
fixture.other: Generated struck harmonic chords; category name does not imply an isolated real piano or guitar
fixture.drums: Seeded noise and swept sine percussion; no pitched-note reference or drum notation claim

settings.overlap_add: linear crossfade normalized by accumulated weights

separation_manifest.time_basis: Each stem frame matches the same frame in the decoded selected mixture; no trimming or time stretching.
limitations: Stem categories are estimates and may contain leakage.
Other is a residual instrument category, not isolated guitar or piano.
Chunked bidirectional inference can differ near boundaries from whole-track inference.

chunking.reconciliation: shared hop lattice; overlap context discarded; full global frame timeline segmented once

cleanup.rule: voiced-island median, persistent semitone hysteresis and deep RMS reattack detection; no silence bridging

manifest.model_score_semantics: pYIN voicing score, not calibrated note accuracy; MIDI velocity is a voicing-derived audition proxy
manifest.limitations: One predominant pitch per frame. Vocal harmonies, breath, vibrato wider than the configured hysteresis, portamento and separation leakage can cause errors. No accompaniment is generated.

cleanup.merge_rule: same pitch/part, bounded gap or overlap, continuous frame activation >=0.3, boundary onset <0.2, local frame rise <0.15

manifest.model_score_semantics: mean model note activation for a raw event; merged notes use the maximum source activation; not calibrated accuracy
manifest.pitch_bend_semantics: original pitch bends are retained in raw-note-events.json and upstream raw-performance.mid where MIDI permits; editable normalized notes currently contain discrete pitches only
manifest.velocity_semantics: MIDI velocity derived by rounding model amplitude * 127; editable and not measured playing force
manifest.original_timing_semantics: earliest source event snapshot; merged source events remain in raw-note-events.json via source_note_ids
